recoveryEvidence: The first incremental typecheck command, npm run typecheck:web, failed because that package script does not exist. The existing tsconfig.web.json command replaced it.

Before the root-owned StewardPanel-root-review.test.tsx fixture was completed, its two assertions passed but Vitest reported two unhandled missing-provider-list exceptions and web TypeScript reported three fixture typing errors. Root repaired only that independent fixture; the final five-file tests and full web TypeScript then passed.

A first guarded edit attempt was decoded by Windows PowerShell 5.1 with the system code page and produced mojibake only in the two edited files. Both files were restored from SHA-256-verified backups before testing. The successful edit used UTF-8 Node content generation plus File.Replace, post-write inspection and cleanup.
limitations: No full-project rerun was performed for this additive UI follow-up.
